hypothesis: Can arbitrary SAT be embedded parsimoniously into the exact U counterexample region satisfying both previous structural filters, with linear source-variable blowup?
topology: Cyclic forcing gadget, parsimonious single-support selector embedding, disjoint irreducible core and quantified same-U residual transfer.
adversarial: Model count must include all auxiliary variables.
Every translated support must be distinct even across original sign variants.
The explicit complete target selector must be charged.
Stage transfer is only from stronger source failure to weaker target failure, not reversible.
scope: Identical U, exact selector input and clocks; injective parsimonious linear-variable reduction of arbitrary source selectors to width-three single-support selectors.
cost: O(L polylog L) sequential multitape translation, polynomial fixed one-tape simulation; exact same-U transfer for each k to some K>=k, no same-exponent transfer.

planner.question: Can arbitrary SAT be embedded parsimoniously into the exact U counterexample region satisfying both previous structural filters, with linear source-variable blowup?
planner.strategy: Use a seven-variable uniquely-zero cyclic gadget, two polarity copies and one fixed dummy per variable; prove exact model correspondence and stage transfer.
planner.alternative: Test the joint value of the previous structural filters by the explicit embedding.
planner.stop_rule: No claim of same-exponent transfer or unbounded cubic failure without a higher-stage source theorem.
literature_leads: Prior exact residual equivalence, complete-support and bijunctive-core results; elementary explicit clause gadgets and fixed tape simulation. No novelty claim.

construct.claim: Every original selector on n variables injectively maps to a complete selector on 3n+7 variables with exactly the same model count and at most one selected clause per support.
construct.scope: Identical U, exact selector input and clocks; injective parsimonious linear-variable reduction of arbitrary source selectors to width-three single-support selectors.
construct.derivation: Cyclic zero gadget, equality copies, forced dummy bits, polarity-dependent literal mapping and zero-guard padding; disjoint supports and unique extensions.
unresolved_steps: Actual unbounded cubic failure or universal cutoff.
candidate_tests: Exhaust gadget and fixed assignments, verify source/target model sets and inverse selector mapping.

alternative.claim: For each fixed k some K>=k gives |B_k(3n+7) intersect C_(3n+7)|>=|B_K(n)| for every n, making the all-exponent failure target exactly equivalent on the normal form.
alternative.scope: Identical U, exact selector input and clocks; injective parsimonious linear-variable reduction of arbitrary source selectors to width-three single-support selectors.
alternative.derivation: Construct image, run actual target stage, project witness; charge polynomial source algorithm and absorb its fixed description/time into K; contrapositive and injection.
unresolved_steps: Numerical K, same-exponent transfer, unconditional unbounded cubic failure.
candidate_tests: Check disjoint dummy supports and single-clause local irreducibility, actual selector order and output verification.
